bendPoints.label: PIA formula bend points
bendPoints.unit: dollars of average indexed monthly earnings, 2026
bendPoints.citation: Dollar amounts in PIA formula, 2026 row

pia.rates.label: PIA formula rates
pia.rates.unit: share of earnings below the first bend point, between the bend points, and above the second
pia.rates.citation: Appendix C: Computing a Retired-Worker Benefit

computationYears.label: Years of earnings counted
computationYears.unit: highest years; missing years count as zero
computationYears.citation: Appendix C: Computing a Retired-Worker Benefit

fullRetirementAge.label: Full retirement age, born 1960 or later
fullRetirementAge.citation: Normal retirement age by year of birth

earlyReduction.label: Reduction for claiming early
earlyReduction.unit: per month early: 5/9 of 1% for the first 36 months, 5/12 of 1% after that

delayedCredit.label: Delayed retirement credit
delayedCredit.unit: per year after full retirement age, up to 70 (born 1943 or later)

estimateMethod.label: Estimator method
estimateMethod.unit: earnings are entered in today's dollars and run through this year's formula, which approximates SSA's wage indexing
estimateMethod.citation: Rough estimate; use your SSA statement for the real figure
